The sample-variance example corrects a source formula that fails for nonzero means. The correction is supported by the displayed covariance calculation and a finite check.

Two run-wide checks remain blocked outside this pair. The full item-level check reports empty inventories and level mismatches in other batches; it reports no batch-21 item errors. The batch-level check cannot recompute because of malformed YAML in two unassigned items: [lem-gaussian-centering…md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-gaussian-centering-for-bounded-symmetric-quasiconvex-loss.md:25) and [thm-brunn-minkowski…md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-brunn-minkowski-for-compact-convex-sets.md:30).
